name: What is a foundation-based tiny home?
description: A foundation-based tiny home is a small dwelling permanently built on a fixed foundation, adhering to local building codes and zoning laws.

mainEntity.name: What is a foundation-based tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A foundation-based tiny home is a small dwelling built on a permanent foundation, similar to a traditional house. Unlike tiny homes on wheels, these structures are considered real property and are subject to local building codes and zoning regulations. They offer long-term stability and are often integrated into existing residential communities, providing a more conventional living experience while embracing the benefits of a smaller footprint. This type of tiny home requires a building permit and compliance with local ordinances.
